Muttātherīgāthā Muttā (2nd) Verses of the Elder Muttā

“Sumuttā sādhumuttāmhi, I’m well freed, so very well freed, “I am well released and fully free, tīhi khujjehi muttiyā; freed from the three things that humped me: free from the three deceits— Udukkhalena musalena, the mortar, the pestle, the mortar, the pestle, patinā khujjakena ca; and my humpbacked husband. and the deceitful husband. Muttāmhi jātimaraṇā, I’m freed from birth and death; I am free from birth and death; bhavanetti samūhatā”ti. the leash to existence is eradicated. I have uprooted that which leads to any state of existence.”

… Muttā therī …. The Elder Muttā
